response.original_title: 【FAQs Guide】How do I upgrade cabin on Royal Caribbean Cruise?
response.overview: To upgrade your cabin on a Royal Caribbean Cruise, call or contact Royal Caribbean Line at ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎︎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) & ☎︎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK). Customer service can review available higher-category staterooms and explain the applicable price difference. If you are already onboard, you can visit Guest Services to ask about an upgrade, subject to availability and additional charges. You can upgrade your cabin on a Royal Caribbean Line cruise by calling ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US customer service, working with a travel agent, or responding to direct email offers sent prior to your departure.Contact Royal Caribbean Line directly at ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) to ask about paying the price difference to move to a higher stateroom category. If you booked through a travel advisor, you must have them handle the modification for you.
